## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle (1卷) expanded altar-ritual (*tányí* 壇儀) for the *fàng yànkǒu* food-bestowal liturgy, supplemented and annotated (*bǔzhù* 補註) by [袾宏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A2%BE%E5%AE%8F) Yúnqī Zhūhóng 雲棲袾宏 (1535–1615), companion volume to *Yúqié jíyào shīshí yíguǐ* 瑜伽集要施食儀軌 ([KR6j0753](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0753)). Preserved as **X59 no. 1081** in the *Xùzàngjīng*.

**Abstract**

The *Tányí* is the expanded ritual companion to the *Yíguǐ* ([KR6j0753](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0753)): where the *Yíguǐ* establishes the canonical form of the dhāraṇī and Sanskrit-syllable visualizations, the *Tányí* establishes the broader altar-construction protocol — the *tán* 壇 (altar) layout, the *yìn* 印 (mudrā) sequence (with thirty-six in total, organized in six *liùhé* 六合 paired-units), and the broader liturgical performance. Zhūhóng's *bǔzhù* annotations correct the most common late-Míng performance errors and recover a cohesive ritual program. The companion volumes [KR6j0753](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0753) and [KR6j0754](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0754) together constitute the canonical Yúnqī ritual-reform of the *yànkǒu* liturgy, foundational for all subsequent Qīng and modern Chinese Buddhist monastic practice. Composition: late-Wànlì period.
